lines.en:
My dear Diana...
You were right...  should have listened...  end times are upon us...  Nephilim, only hope...
Who did this?  Who could destroy my Paladins and overcome the Temple?  And what of my family?!
lines.zh: 这是谁干的？ 谁能击溃我的圣骑士、征服了圣殿？ 我的家人呢？！
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en:
Follow...  the prophecy...   You must take this key, to the Temple archives...  forbidden pages of the book...
Make the pilgrimage, Diana...  Back to where it all began...
Come on, I need more!!  Wake up!!
lines.zh: 不要死，我需要更多消息！！ 快醒来！！
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: ...  I will make this right, Grandmaster.  Watch me from the heavens.  I will see you there soon, victorious or not.
lines.zh: …… 我会纠正这一切的，圣宗。 在天堂看着吧。 不论输赢，我们很快就会在上面相聚了。
lines.name: 戴安娜
